intro.x: All of the mines in the cavern consist of 40 levels with an elevator every five floors, except for the 35th, and a reward chest every tenth. Once the player reaches the bottom, they unlock the next available mine in the order: Earth, Water, Wind, and Fire.

As the player progresses through the mines, the types of stone they encounter become harder to break, requiring more powerful upgrades to the pickaxe to make efficient progress. The distribution includes generic rocks that can be found across all mines and those that are unique to certain mines. Examples of what the different types of stone look like can be found in the gallery below.
In v0.3, gem nodes have been reworked to potentially occur across all mines at varying odds.
After completing two offerings at the [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]], Mystery Rocks will start to appear on every floor. Completing more offerings will allow more Mystery Rocks to spawn on each floor.
Breaking open Mystery Rocks may yield ores, ore veins, seeds, fish, insects, or monsters.

article.x: The Earth mine is the first mine the player will be able to enter. [[bronze-ore|Bronze ore]] and [[earth-geode|earth geode]]s can be found in the Earth mine. Every tenth floor of the mine contains a reward chest for the player to claim. Once the player reaches the bottom, they will unlock the Water mine.
